## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case
Explain why this feature would be useful. What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Example Implementation
If you have ideas about how this could be implemented, share them here:

```latex
% Example LaTeX code showing the proposed feature
```

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
- Screenshots or mockups (if applicable)
- Examples from other templates or publications
- Any other context about the feature request

## Impact
- [ ] This would affect all users
- [ ] This would be an optional feature
- [ ] This would require breaking changes

## Compatibility
- [ ] Compatible with LuaLaTeX only
- [ ] Should work with pdfLaTeX too
- [ ] Requires new packages

## Priority
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical - Can't use template without it
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor convenience
